title: dp/status/v1
description: The F3411 Display Provider's own status, published by dp-poller on core NATS subject dp.v1.status every status interval (DP_STATUS_INTERVAL_MS) whatever Service Providers it holds, in the 04 §2 envelope. picture-ws reads it to tell a Display Provider with nothing to poll (the DSS answering, no ISA in any viewed area: dp_state idle) from one that is silent, unconfigured or cut off from the DSS (dp_unavailable). Each Service Provider's row stays on src.v1.network_rid.<uss_id> (source/status/v1). Internal to this system (NATS never crosses a system, M30); owned by uspace-authority (WP-14).

dss.description: ok: the last ISA search answered; dss_unavailable: it failed; dss_unconfigured: no DSS_BASE_URL; unknown: no search yet (nothing viewed, or just started).

dss_since.description: Since when the DSS is in a state other than ok.

tiles.description: Root tiles of the viewed areas searched for ISAs.

providers.description: Service Providers the held ISAs name.

unpolled_isas.description: ISAs in view whose Service Provider cannot be polled (an owner that is not a subject token, a refused or clashing uss_base_url, DP_MAX_PROVIDERS reached): their flights are missing, and picture-ws says dp_isas_unpolled.
